resources.string:
Could not enable monitor mode on %1$s.

Why:
• The chipset does not support it — most built-in non-Qualcomm radios do not.
• The adapter is undetected or unplugged.
• The interface is busy, down, or named differently by the driver.

Fixes:
• Settings → Network interfaces: pick another adapter for handshake and deauth.
• Re-plug the USB adapter, then rescan.
• Use a monitor-capable adapter (Atheros AR9271, Realtek RTL8812AU / 88XXAU).
• Settings → Custom monitor commands: adjust how monitor mode is enabled.
• Turn off Android Wi-Fi or hotspot if it is holding the interface.
